name: classic-city-core/comparison-table
title: Comparison Table
description: Us against them, one metric at a time. Each row names a metric and draws two paired bars — ours and theirs — scaled against each other rather than against a shared total, so every metric keeps its own units. Bar lengths are derived from the values server-side, and a row whose two values are not in the same unit prints without bars instead of drawing a false picture.
